Class Building

java.lang.Object
domain.Building
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Building extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a specific building instance that can be constructed at a station. A Building is based on a BuildingType, which defines its name, cost, effect, and availability year. This class acts as a wrapper around BuildingType and is used to associate buildings with stations in the simulation.
